key_patterns: Enum migrations use `do $$ begin if not exists (select 1 from pg_type where typname=...) then create type ... end if; end$$;` (see 0002). Vendor column privilege rules live in guard_vendor_columns() (0004) + RLS (0005), NOT in the API. order_status/transition legal set is mirrored between C# OrderService.Legal and SQL transition_order, kept in sync by a C# test. Pre-order Switch wired as `setPreorder = (on) => setPreorderEnabled(vid, on)` in Dashboard. Student/vendor cancel reuses the one `cancelOrder` reason-prompt handler in OrderStatus.jsx.
